R424.note: Adds extension allowlist, size cap, UUID filename and path containment check; filename/size restrictions are the correct primary fix for unrestricted-upload and are disclosed, response shape preserved.

R425.note: Minimal, correct fix: appends separator to BASE_DIR before startsWith, closing the sibling-directory bypass with no other change.

R426.note: Detected-mime extension + UUID filename stored outside static root, served via new sanitized /avatars/:filename route; success/error JSON shapes match the stated contract.

R427.note: Adds antiforgery service/middleware plus explicit ValidateRequestAsync in the JSON-bound handler (middleware alone would not cover it); preserves auth, QueueAsync call, and 202 response for valid-token callers per contract.

R428.note: Adds .RequireAuthorization() to the minimal-API DELETE route, matching the authentication-only protection already used by the sibling MVC controller; no ownership check added or removed.

R429.note: Switching to fast-xml-parser structurally prevents external entity/DTD resolution, closing XXE, but the parser's default parseTagValue option silently coerces the numeric orderId from string to number in the JSON response, an undisclosed behavior change.

R430.note: Replaces strcat/strcpy with bounds-checked snprintf at both write points, preserving the function's 0/-1 contract and rejecting only inputs that would have overflowed.

R431.note: Rejects filenames containing ':' '/' '\' (blocking stream-wrapper and traversal payloads) then canonicalizes with realpath and checks separator-terminated containment; matches the reports-directory's plain-filename design.

R432.note: Path.GetFullPath + Path.GetRelativePath containment check correctly rejects both absolute-path override and '..' traversal while still allowing any path that resolves inside the reports root.

R433.note: Wraps exportUsersHandler with the existing requireAdmin middleware, mirroring the ban/unban routes; no other change.

R434.note: Replaces raw-socket command string construction with Commons Net FTPClient.retrieveFile(), passing the filename as a structured argument rather than concatenating it into the RETR command; also fixes the literal (non-substituted) password string, disclosed in the write-up.

R435.note: Adds an unsigned bounds check against MAX_PLAYERS before the array write; valid indices unaffected.

R436.note: Drops cmd.exe /c string concatenation for a direct ProcessBuilder argument-array invocation of ping.exe, closing shell metacharacter injection; output capture behavior unchanged for legitimate host/count values.

R437.note: Maps the tool parameter through a fixed allowlist to a canonical executable path; the app's own doc comment defines diagnostics as 'a handful' of named tools, so the allowlist matches the intended value domain rather than over-restricting it.
